events.extended_summary: The US has announced a reward of up to $20 million for information about Iran's nuclear programme. The State Department's Rewards for Justice is also offering to potentially relocate the person who provides such details. President Donald Trump claimed last year that Iran's nuclear facilities had been "completely and totally obliterated" following a bombing campaign by the US and Israel. Iran insists its nuclear programme is peaceful and that it has no intention of developing a nuclear weapon. Meanwhile, the US military says it is setting up a task force to enhance Washington's efforts to restrict Iran's movement of weapons and sanctioned material across its borders. The US military's Central Command (Centcom) said Task Force Iron Gate would operate from Tampa, Florida, and would work with other US government agencies. events.extended_summary: Israel’s opposition leader Gadi Eisenkot, the man officially tasked by President Isaac Herzog with trying to form the country’s next government, has said that he was open to including Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu in his coalition lineup. In a speech at Sunday’s ceremony in Herzog’s office in Jerusalem, Eisenkot suggested Netanyahu’s far-right Finance Minister Bezalel Smotrich was also welcome to join. “If members of Likud and the Religious Zionist Party truly believe this is a time for unity, as they told the president, I cannot conceive of any reason why they would not support a government under my leadership and the principles I have presented,” Eisenkot said. Eisenkot, who ran as Netanyahu’s main rival, has six weeks to form a new government. events.extended_summary: Jensen Huang admitted having an extramarital affair and said he would cooperate into a security investigation launched by the tech giant US tech giant Nvidia has opened an independent investigation following reports its CEO Jensen Huang had a relationship with a suspected Chinese spy. The company, one of the most valuable in the world, said its board had no reason to believe the company's secrets or national security were compromised, adding that the CEO was committed to continuing to lead the company. Separately, Jensen Huang admitted to having been "unfaithful" to his wife and apologised for hurting her and their children. US intelligence officials believed that Chinese businesswoman Alice Huang, who had a close relationship with Jensen Huang, was a spy for Beijing, according to a New York Times report. events.extended_summary: Manchester United scored twice in stoppage time to salvage a 4-4 draw with Aston Villa at Old Trafford, leaving them in the relegation zone. Villa went 2-0 up within four minutes through Alysson and Nicolas Jackson, but United fought back to level before half-time. After Villa regained the lead in the second half, Joshua Zirkzee scored in the 92nd minute and Patrick Dorgu headed a 97th-minute equalizer from a corner. Villa manager Unai Emery walked down the tunnel before the final whistle, believing the match was ending, while Villa complained about the legitimacy of United's fourth goal. United have not won a Premier League game since August.
events.micro_summary: Manchester United salvaged a 4-4 draw with Aston Villa with two stoppage-time goals at Old Trafford.
events.summary: Manchester United scored twice in stoppage time to draw 4-4 with Aston Villa at Old Trafford, with Patrick Dorgu heading a 97th-minute equalizer after Joshua Zirkzee's 92nd-minute goal.

events.extended_summary: Kaizer Chiefs joined Mamelodi Sundowns and Orlando Pirates in the Carling Knockout semifinals after defeating Siwelele FC 2-1 at Peter Mokaba Stadium in Polokwane on Sunday. Siwelele took the lead through Siyabonga Ndebele in the 12th minute, but Wandile Duba equalised from a penalty in first-half injury time and substitute Asanele Velebayi scored the decisive goal in the 84th minute. Meanwhile, Orlando Pirates secured a 1-0 victory over Sekhukhune United at home to advance, setting up an away semifinal against Stellenbosch, who sealed a dramatic 2-1 win over AmaZulu. All four remaining teams progressed by single-goal margins in tightly contested quarterfinal matches.
events.micro_summary: Kaizer Chiefs and Orlando Pirates secured Carling Knockout semifinal spots with 2-1 and 1-0 victories.
events.summary: Kaizer Chiefs defeated Siwelele FC 2-1 at Peter Mokaba Stadium to reach the Carling Knockout semifinals, joining Mamelodi Sundowns and Orlando Pirates, who beat Sekhukhune United 1-0. Stellenbosch also advanced after a 2-1 win over AmaZulu.

events.extended_summary: The New Orleans Saints secured their first home win of the 2026 season with a 23-22 overtime victory over the Cleveland Browns on Sunday at the Caesars Superdome. The winning score came on a 15-yard touchdown catch by tight end Juwan Johnson with 4:17 to play in overtime. The Browns marched down the field and scored on a 39-yard touchdown pass to tight end Harold Fannin Jr. with 1:00 to play but their two-point attempt failed, giving the Saints the victory. The victory improved the Saints, coming off of their bye week, to 3-5 and 1-3 at home. The loss dropped the Browns to 5-4. Pending the result of "Sunday Night Football," the Saints are tied for first in the NFC South. Saints quarterback Tyler Shough was 21 of 35 for 265 yards and a touchdown. events.extended_summary: Australia defeated Samoa 44-12 in the Rugby League World Cup semi-final at Allianz Stadium in Sydney, advancing to next weekend's final against New Zealand in Brisbane. Reece Walsh scored a hat-trick and celebrated with a backflip, while Tom Dearden, Jacob Preston, Tom Trbojevic, Brandon Best and Jack Bostock also scored tries as the Kangaroos ran in eight total. The match featured pre-game tension when Samoa players confronted Australian players during the Siva Tau, and whistles were heard during a moment of silence for late legend Paul Langmack. The 41,529 crowd at Allianz Stadium witnessed Australia's victory, moving them one game away from a fourth consecutive World Cup title. Walsh's performance included scoring his first try after the half-hour mark and setting up another for Bostock. New Zealand, who defeated Tonga in the other semi-final, will face Australia in the final on Sunday night.
events.micro_summary: Australia defeated Samoa 44-12 in the World Cup semi-final to reach the final against New Zealand.
events.summary: Australia thrashed Samoa 44-12 in the Rugby League World Cup semi-final at Allianz Stadium in Sydney, with Reece Walsh scoring a hat-trick, to set up a final against New Zealand next weekend in Brisbane.

events.extended_summary: At least five people, including four children, were killed after heavy rains caused a sandbank to collapse in central Gaza. Several injured people were pulled from tents hit in Deir el-Balah on Sunday, while rescue teams continued searching for survivors. Heavy rain and strong winds since late Friday flooded approximately 70,000 tents and brought down dozens of walls across the Gaza Strip, damaging shelters belonging to tens of thousands of displaced Palestinians. Nearly 400,000 displaced people are sheltering in locations considered highly vulnerable to further flooding. Ninety percent of Gaza residents have been displaced by the ongoing conflict, with many lacking adequate protection from harsh weather. Aid restrictions have worsened conditions, leaving families without food aid and proper shelter as the rainy season begins.
events.micro_summary: At least five people, including four children, died when heavy rains collapsed a sandbank in central Gaza.
events.summary: At least five people, including four children, were killed when heavy rains caused a sandbank to collapse in central Gaza, while flooding damaged shelters for tens of thousands of displaced Palestinians across the territory.

events.extended_summary: Seven teenagers and the driver of a car were hospitalised after a road traffic incident in south Dublin on Sunday. The car, driven by a woman in her 40s, struck a group of six young pedestrians, three boys and three girls aged between 13 and 15, outside a row of shops on Oliver Plunkett Road in the Monkstown-Monkstown Farm area, close to Dún Laoghaire, at about 3pm. Some of the teenagers are being treated for critical injuries, with three admitted to Children’s Health Ireland (CHI) Temple Street and three to CHI Crumlin. A 15-year-old witness to the incident was also admitted to CHI Tallaght for medical attention. The driver of the car remained in hospital on Sunday night and was receiving medical care. events.extended_summary: Union Electronics and Information Technology Minister Ashwini Vaishnaw stated that India aims to become the world's application capital for artificial intelligence, shifting focus from building models to deploying practical applications across key sectors. He identified agriculture, healthcare and education as areas where AI could transform farming practices, improve service delivery and reshape learning for the young population. The minister emphasized that Indian industry is already developing real-world AI applications with encouraging progress, offering businesses opportunities to transform operations. Concurrently, the government is finalizing a consultation paper on AI regulation, having examined international frameworks and consulted stakeholders including academics. The upcoming public consultation will address AI safety, the spread of deepfakes, potential psychological impacts on users, and skilling requirements to manage the technology's risks.
events.micro_summary: India aims to become the world's AI application capital, focusing on agriculture, healthcare and education sectors.
events.summary: India aims to become the world's artificial intelligence application capital, deploying AI across agriculture, healthcare and education while preparing a consultation paper on regulation covering safety, deepfakes and psychological impacts.

The tremor rattled several areas, shattering shop windows and prompting people to flee buildings. No tsunami warning was issued.The earthquake struck at around 1.04 am local time, with its epicentre in the western part of Shizuoka Prefecture, at a depth of approximately 40 km, according to the Japan Meteorological Agency (JMA).As per a report by Japan Today, the strongest shaking was recorded in Aichi Prefecture, where the city of Chita experienced an upper 5 on Japan's seven-level seismic intensity scale. Tremors were also felt in neighbouring prefectures, including Nagano and Gifu.According to the latest updates, at least 22 people have been injured in the earthquake.
